s: suffix in nouns indicating appurtenance, i.e. accessories or things subordinate to a bigger entity
suffix in agent and instrumental nouns
-el.et: From Middle High German -el, from Old High German -il, direct descendant of Proto-West Germanic *-il, from Proto-Germanic *-ilaz, or from dialectal variants of -lein, which as well ultimately go back to *-ilaz or to *-ilingaz.
